tracks.full_text: Hello, and welcome to WBCO financial news. Tonight, we're talking about the prices we pay online for goods and services. In particular, we'll look at why you may pay more if you shop during times of peak demand. Called surge pricing, this trend first started with computer software that allowed large airlines to track demand and quickly change their ticket prices. That technology is now widely available.
